Hi Elise —

Great to reconnect after our onboarding review last week. For the upcoming Renewal QBR + roadmap demo, the customer's stakeholder availability is tight so we'd like to propose a small operational tweak that keeps the meeting compact while protecting exec time: a rolling-slot format where we run a 45-minute live demo (core roadmap + 15 min Qs) and offer a parallel 30-minute recorded deep-dive for engineering and ops.

Quick asks from our side:
- Can you confirm if recording is allowed for the technical deep-dive (we can mark the exec portion as non-recorded)?
- From the attached slot grid (qbr-slot-grid-v2.xlsx) pick one preferred slot and one backup.
- If either is a hard no, let us know and we can propose two alternate days.

Attachments: qbr-slot-grid-v2.xlsx (slot matrix), run_of_show-draft.pdf (proposed split)

Proposed initial options (your TZ):
- Option A: Wed Oct 27, 10:00–10:45 PT (exec + roadmap) + 11:00–11:30 PT (recorded tech deep-dive)
- Option B: Thu Oct 28, 14:00–14:45 PT + 15:00–15:30 PT

If those look ok I’ll lock in invites and share a slimmed run-of-show. Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround.

—
Mina Haddad

- Of the two, Option A works best for our leadership team. Backup Option B is acceptable but would prefer if the recorded deep-dive starts no later than 11:00 PT.

One more ask: we need a short ops checklist (participants, data access, test tenant) included in the invite so our platform team can sign off ahead of time.

I’ve attached a placeholder PO in case we need procurement on the calendar quickly.
